'''Æthillu''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A phantom that answered Ardashir's call. It is a manifestation of destruction, a sedimentation of ancient senescence.}}

==Overview==
Æthillu initially use a melee attack to strike its opponent, with no extra ability. After being defeated once, revives after a short delay, during which it is not attackable.

The revived Æthillu (indicated by being glowed up) has extra abilities:
*Attack more frequent, being more aggressive, attacks has longer range.
*Lose HP over time.
*When defeated, trigger an explosion at the location, dealing large AOE Aether DMG.
